Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specialized in storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company is located in the city of Ghent in Belgium, and the company has branches all over the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in the field of logistics and supply chain management. The company offers a wide range of services, including warehouse management, transport and distribution, packaging, quality control, and customs clearance.Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

 

 

 

 

 

Jobomschrijving

 

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.
• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.
• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.
• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.
• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.
 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.
• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.
• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.
• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.
• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.
• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.
• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.
• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift
• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.
• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.
• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

Job Description:

•

For our sites in Neder-over-Heembeek and Brucargo, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician who maintains and optimises industrial installations with dedication and expertise.

You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability of our technical systems. We invest in safety, training and your development, and we value your technical expertise. Together, we build a future based on innovation, reliability and teamwork.

Your responsibilities

 
• Preventive maintenance: carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance plan and inspect machines to avoid breakdowns.
 
• Corrective & improvement maintenance: analyse and resolve faults, replace or adjust parts, consult technical documentation and ensure optimal machine performance.
 
• Optimisation: analyse recurring issues and propose improvement actions to increase performance and availability.
 
• Use of CMMS: record interventions, write fault analyses, prepare reports and monitor stock levels.
 
• Safety: ensure a clean and safe working environment and actively contribute to safety improvements.
 
• Support & training: provide technical support to colleagues and operational teams.
 
• Quality & environment: work in accordance with current procedures (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001).

 
• Solid technical background (mechanics, electricity or electromechanics). 
 
• Autonomous, thorough and solution‑oriented. 
 
• Experience with industrial installations is an asset. Knowledge of CMMS systems is a plus. 
 
• Strong safety awareness, quality‑oriented and eager to learn. 
 
• Willing to work in a 3‑shift system (Mon–Fri). 
 
• Excellent command of English; knowledge of French / Dutch is an advantage

As a Accountant, you will monitor, analyse, and report key expense categories while ensuring accurate financial reporting and effective cost control. Acting as a business partner to various departments, you will provide valuable insights that support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Omschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You’ll perform regular maintenance and minor repairs, keeping your workspace organized and efficient. Collaboration is key, so you’ll hand over tasks smoothly to your colleagues to maintain seamless production.Ready to make your mark in a future-focused company? Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth and development.

• Strong technical insight, preferably with a technical degree

• Ability to work independently and with precision

• Hands-on attitude, ready to assist wherever needed

• Flexibility to switch machines or work overtime when necessary

• At least 5 years of experience as a folding operator in a printing company

• Experience with perfect binding is a plus

• Proficient in English

Responsibilities:

At this position, your tasks will be highly varied. One day you might be performing (preventive) maintenance on industrial compressors, while the next you could be conducting complex repairs on a generator. In short, you'll have plenty of technical challenges and day-to-day variety.

• Conduct maintenance and repairs on rental equipment such as diesel generators and compressors to ensure optimal performance and safety

• Perform scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance routines to guarantee fleet reliability

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including mechanical and electrical problems, on site or in the workshop

• Prepare equipment efficiently after use to ensure readiness for the next customer

• Document maintenance activities and communicate technical findings clearly to team members and clients

• At least 2/3 years as a workshop technician/ engineer
• Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or a related technical field
• Strong knowledge of diesel engines, compressors, and electrical systems, including reading electrical diagrams 
• Fluency in English, with excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation
• Proven problem solving skills, results oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently or in a team
• Flexibility regarding working hours and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning and development

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code.
